hebrew: שְׁמַע קוֹלֵנוּ ה' אֱלֹהֵינוּ, חוּס וְרַחֵם עָלֵינוּ, וְקַבֵּל בְּרַחֲמִים וּבְרָצוֹן אֶת־תְּפִלָּתֵנוּ.
translation:
Hear our voice, O Lord our God; spare us and have mercy upon us, and accept our prayers in mercy and favor.

Translation from The Standard Prayer book by Simeon Singer (1915) (public domain)
information: From the daily Amidah, also features in the High Holiday service

recordings.description: Traditional melody from the Blue Book
